references.sentence: In the proposed work, the gain-corrected residue is directly sampled onto the next-stage sampling capacitance, as illustling. trated in Fig. 15.8.1, thereby eliminating the extra signal path for error sampling and forwarding.
In Fig. 15.8.2, the nonlinearity-cancelling mechanism is explained using signal transfer functions at the top and the bottom plates.
Figure 15.8.3 shows a Miller-compensated 2-stage uncascoded opamp along with a diodeloaded differential pair monitoring the opamp summing node.
The full-scale signal range is 2Vpp. Figure 15.8.4 explains how the zero-forcing servo-feedback algorithm finds the optimum gain setting.
The die photo is shown in Fig. 15.8.7.
